desc: 旋转提手翻盖吸管，哑黑钛银配荧光橙运动场，空白标注收口
name: 曜黑运动提手翻盖吸管杯款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里用完整直立剪影与竖起提手一眼赢得点击，交付干净合规的平台主图。
一秒交代核心利益：暗场上的高对比剪影加左上空标题带，把主张位留给买家自填。
用掀开的翻盖与立起的硬质吸水嘴微距，一眼交代饮口怎么用、怎么密封。
复刻训练末端力竭、够水解渴的真实一刻，把痛点与产品解决动作放在同一画面。
俯视交代提手、铆钉转轴与可拆吸水嘴三处结构，用空引线替买家回答好不好清洗。
把产品放进外出补水的真实动作里，让买家代入日常随身饮水的一天。
同型由低到高并排一次看全身形差异，帮买家在一次浏览里完成选款。
保留三列对照表的阅读结构，把全部主张与判定位留成空白由买家自填。
以整块高饱和强调场与旋到一侧的提手定格收口，把加购语位置留在干净留白里。

style.backgroundSystem: one flat solid field per screen on a graphite sports system: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for the packshot and the overhead hardware screen, deep graphite #14161A for the headline hero and the comparison matrix, cold ash #ECEDEF for macro and size line-up screens, dark rubber gym floor #24262A for the training frame, board-formed concrete #A9A6A2 for the refill frame, and one saturated fluorescent-orange field #FF6A13 held only for the closing screen; never a gradient, never a mixed or random environment
style.direction: athletic graphite drinkware commerce with a single high-voltage accent
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight leader arrows and rounded label plates in fluorescent orange #FF6A13 on light fields and in titanium #C7CBD1 on dark fields, flat matte, no glossy three-dimensional badges, no rendered check or cross marks
style.lightingSystem: cool-neutral studio light with a large front-left key and a low fill card, one controlled specular rolling along the brushed metal collar, crisp separating rim on the dark fields, soft contact shadows grounding every unit, one skimming sweep reserved for the macro screens, no harsh hotspots
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent athletic graphite drinkware visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless pure white #FFFFFF, cold ash #ECEDEF, deep graphite #14161A and one fluorescent-orange accent #FF6A13 with brushed titanium detail #C7CBD1; neutral colour temperature held across every frame with no warm cast; one flat solid field per screen, no gradient and no mixed environment; cool-neutral studio lighting with a large front-left key, low fill card, one controlled specular on the metal collar, crisp separating rim on dark fields, soft contact shadows and one skimming sweep reserved for the macro frames; modern geometric sans-serif kept for post compositing while every rendered frame carries only blank rounded label plates, empty leader arrows, empty table cells and an empty call-to-action pill; thin single-weight flat leader icons in #FF6A13 on light fields and #C7CBD1 on dark fields; stable tall tapered upright body with a wide metal collar band and an arched carry handle, constant product scale and never-drifting matte finish; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no gradient backdrops, no rendered words or numbers.
noDrift: no gradient or textured studio backdrops
no rendered words, letters, digits or units anywhere in frame
no invented spec numbers, hours, percentages or material grades
style.presentationRules: one constant tall tapered body with a wide metal collar band and an arched carry handle at one stable scale; the handle stands upright on the first screens and swings to the side only on the closing screen; matte body tone never drifts toward glossy or toward a warm cast
style.surfaceSystem: seamless white sweep #FFFFFF, matte cold-ash board #ECEDEF, deep graphite block #14161A, brushed titanium edge detail #C7CBD1, dark rubber gym matting #24262A and board-formed concrete #A9A6A2 for the two live frames
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif reserved for post compositing only; every rendered frame carries blank rounded label plates, empty leader arrows, empty table cells and an empty call-to-action pill, no in-image copy at all
